verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a CRM like Sales Cloud, but the evidence pack never documents retention policies, deletion controls, or data purge capabilities. The closest item, ABAC access policies, covers who can see data, not how long it is kept or how it is deleted, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
